//: The CLI runs on Node, not on Metro: the app's own config targets a bundler and emits nothing. Node cannot run the engine's TypeScript directly (it uses constructor parameter properties, which type stripping refuses), so the tool is compiled to CommonJS here — app/package.json declares no module type — and run from .build. Only the entry points are listed: tsc pulls in what they import, so src/ui and the expo-file-system sinks never enter this compile.
